final: WITH base AS (SELECT s.telescref AS telescope_id, o.weathprofile AS weather, s.modindex AS modidx, s.phaseshiftdeg AS phase FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), step1 AS (SELECT telescope_id, weather, AVG(modidx) AS a, AVG(phase) AS p FROM base GROUP BY telescope_id, weather), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.weather AS weather, s1.a AS a, s1.p AS p, s1.a - s2.b AS diff FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.b) SELECT weather, AVG(a), AVG(p), AVG(diff) FROM step3 GROUP BY weather ORDER BY weather
